takeaway: Only by changing its four propeller speeds: speed up the back pair to tilt and fly forward, and speed up one spinning pair to turn.

selfCheck.question: Why do two propellers spin one way and two the other?
selfCheck.answer: same way -> keeps spinning; two each way cancel, hover without rotating; turn by speeding up one pair; clockwise pair faster -> drone turns counter-clockwise.

sentence: A drone has no wings or rudder, so it steers only by changing how fast each of its four propellers spins. Speeding up some propellers and slowing others tips it so it flies forward or makes it turn on the spot. A flight computer keeps adjusting the four speeds many times a second to hold it steady.
